simple.meaning: חָתָה (châthâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to lay hold of; especially to pick up fire.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 4 times in Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, beginning at Psalms 52:7. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָתָה (H2846) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חָתָה (châthâh) / H2846 is traced through Psalms 52:7, Proverbs 6:27, Proverbs 25:22, Isaiah 30:14 with source-language evidence and verse context.

Can a man scoop fire into his lap,
for you will heap coals of fire on his head,

definitions.full: H2846. chathah [ חָתָה ] verb snatch up , usually fire, coals (Late Hebrew id. ; חֲתָא ᵑ7 , id. (rare); Assyrian —atû is destroy (i.e. snatch away ? ) see SASm Asrb i. 90 ) — Qal Imperfect יַחְתֶּה Prov 6:27 ; suffix יַחְתְּךָ Psa 52:7 ; Infinitive construct לַחְתּוֺת Isa 30:14 ; Participle חֹתֶה Prov 25:22 ; — snatch up , with accusative מִיָּקוּד אֵשׁ Isa 30:14 to snatch up fire from a hearth (|| מִגֶּבֶא מים לַחְשׂף ); בְּחֵיקוֺ אֵשׁ Prov 6:27 shall a man snatch up fire in his bosom and his garments not be burned ? (in simile of adulterer); pregnantly seize (and put) upon ח אַתָּה ׳גְּחָלִים עלרֿאֹשׁוֺ 25:22 ; מֵאֹ֑הֶל וְיִסָּֽחֲךָ יַחְתְּךָ Psa 52:7 God . . . shall snatch thee away , and pluck thee up tent-less.
